name: Estonian Open 2010

venue.name: [Kose Gymnasium](http://www.kose.edu.ee/w3)
venue.details: Harju County (40 km South East of Tallinn, Estonia)

information: [Schedule](http://www.wombat.pri.ee/failid/Ajakava2010eng.pdf). Only competition in the Baltic countries! Participation fee will be 150 EEK (100 for the competition and 50 for the two lunches) or just 10 €. Transportation from Tallinn and accommodation will be organized. For more information visit the competition website. The goal is to make this a Rubik's competition where the most records are made (last year there were even 2 WR!). [Images from last year](http://www.wombat.pri.ee/fotod/EstonianOpen09/).
